**(00:00-00:10):** A direct overhead, top-down shot frames a white ceramic frying pan resting on an electric stovetop. A person uses a wooden spoon to stir around a baby pacifier, a metal house key, and two rings (a wedding band and an engagement ring) inside the dry pan. Bright, direct indoor kitchen lighting clearly illuminates the scene with sharp focus. Single continuous shot.

- Humorous demonstration of financial strain caused by simultaneous major life events (having a baby, renovating a home).

- Accompanied by upbeat pop music lyrics matching a trending social media format.
